method: Context-only analysis of exactly the 119 locked Stage 2 candidates. No player/market added; no historical sample, hit rate, ladder, P15, or Stage 2 alternate band changed. Classifications are qualitative, not probabilities.

sources.name: Sports Injury Central Week 11 matchup preview

research_limitations: Individual snap, route, target, carry, and matchup splits were not independently verified for every candidate. Unavailable factors are marked unverified/Mixed rather than inferred.
Game-level injury information is shared across candidates in the same matchup; it does not establish an individual player's projected workload.
Weather detail is available for Steelers-Eagles and Jaguars-Giants in the reviewed Saturday injury watch; no unsupported weather assumptions are added for other games.
Geno Smith's status is inconsistent across reviewed reports; confirm official active/inactive status before selection.
Stage 3 is context only, not final prop selection.
